title: On a slow line, a message sent from the assistant can go out twice
what: When the owner presses Send on a message card and the server takes longer than 15 seconds to answer, the panel gives up waiting, but the server may still send the message. The card then says it did not save, gives the credit back and offers Send again with a fresh task. Pressing Send again sends the same message a second time to every member, because nothing tells the server it is the same message.
expected: A message carries its own one-time mark, so a second Send of the same card is recognised by the server and not sent again; or the card checks Sent messages before offering Send again.
how_often: only on a slow or dropping internet line
fix_line: Give each message send a one-time mark the server checks, like payments already have

title: When an assistant save fails or a credit cannot be given back, only the owner's own browser knows
what: Every assistant failure the owner sees (a save that did not go through, a credit that could not be given back, the AI not reachable, a message that did not send) is written only to the hidden browser console on the owner's computer. The panel's crash reporter only catches errors nobody handled, and these are all handled. MettleUp HQ sees failed AI answers per gym when someone looks, but nothing alerts anyone, and failed saves and lost credits are not recorded anywhere MettleUp can read. A gym that lost credits would be the first to know.
expected: Failed saves and failed credit give-backs are sent to the same crash report store (no personal details), and a daily line or alert shows how many happened.
who: MettleUp team, and owners who lose credits
fix_line: Send handled assistant failures to the existing crash report store and count them daily

title: Nobody can tell which assistant ideas and answers owners actually use
what: The server keeps how many questions each gym asked, how many failed, and each task's status (drafted, done, cancelled). But the Today ideas, their See who lists, and the many answers worked out in the browser without the AI leave no count at all. Whether owners use the ideas, or which answers matter, is decided blind.
expected: A simple count, with no personal details, of ideas shown and tapped and of answer cards opened, per gym per day.
fix_line: Count ideas shown and tapped and local answers opened, per gym per day

items.reason: No backup code in this area; the credit and task tables are backed up (or not) server-wide, and a restore test needs a live database action
The assistant has no scheduled job; the panel worker's timed jobs are the payment check and crash cleanup only
The only timer here is the 30-second voice recording; its clock reads real time, so a background tab does not slow it. Watch and heart-rate states do not apply to a web page.
